snippet.title: Kinsfolk - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Kinsfolk is an emotional single-player adventure game. You will embark on a journey to discover the meaning of family. Explore the beautiful world with atmospheric music. Discover and relive stories about the past.

Kinsfolk will be available on January 8th, and will be available on PC.
